_comment: Landfall claude-play sweep flag 1 (2026-10-16; seed 31009 gi9 T2): ONE Forest in play, hand Khalni
Heart Expedition ({1}{G}) + Forest. 'Cast Khalni, THEN play the Forest' (`landat=1`) cannot be paid --
the Expedition needs the Forest's mana -- and was offered anyway (the position clone inherited casts
enumerated WITH the land); picked, it dropped Khalni and played the Forest. The position is no

('Forest, then Khalni') stays the legal line.
